title: JSON-safe task database mutation promotion
minimumPromotionPolicy: Task database promotion requires JSON-only descriptors and patches, explicit owner/id mapping, stable errors, schema migration and rollback evidence, packaged row ownership, user-visible disclosure, Safe downgrade, and no raw task, scheduler, cursor, or mutable row handles crossing into Node.

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-17 reserves JSON-safe task mutation operations and keeps require("tasks") unexposed.
P13-21 provides work_manager, compat.tasks migration, and read-only TimedTask snapshot evidence.
The task_database provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The task_database provider declares disable flag, diagnostic, disclosure, stop-action, task-removal, relaunch, crash, and Safe downgrade proof requirements.
P15-12 owns P14-17 under pro.tasks_device_media with provider_mutation_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Live provider evidence for add, update, enable, disable, remove, list, and get over JSON descriptors and patches without raw task objects.
Owner and id mapping evidence proving Node ids, legacy TimedTask ids, packaged task ids, project identity, and package identity cannot alias across owners.
P15-13 schema version, downgrade, corruption recovery, unknown-version fail-closed, backup, and rollback fixtures.
Daily/weekly wall-clock scheduler evidence covering timezone and clock changes, reboot, Doze, exact-alarm permission, WorkManager/JobScheduler fallback, and quota diagnostics.
P15-14 packaged APK add/list/enable-disable/remove smoke proving packaged row ownership, disclosure, process death/relaunch behavior, task removal, and Safe downgrade policy.
Cross-package and main-app alias denial evidence for packaged and legacy rows.
User-visible disclosure, foreground notification ownership, stop action, task removal cleanup, relaunch, and crash recovery evidence.
Safe downgrade proof that disabling task_database preserves rows and denies package-owned mutations.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 synchronize docs, TypeScript declarations, security corpus, migration, compatibility, and release notes before task_database can be marked promoted.
